question: How much does Customer pay for the Professional Plan, and how is it billed?
ground_truth_answer: $1,200 per month for up to ten (10) users, billed annually in advance, totaling $14,400 per year.

expected_citations.span_hint: Customer subscribes to the Professional Plan for up to ten (10) users at $1,200 per month, billed annually in advance ($14,400 per year).
